svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: SPI write timing
svg.desc: SPI write timing of the ISF15ACP4's SSD1331 controller in mode 0: CS# low frames one byte, D/C# selects command or data, and SDIN is read on each rising SCLK edge, most significant bit first, with the times of Table 21.
svg.text: SPI mode 0 (CPOL 0, CPHA 0). Sources: ctl 12 AC Characteristics, Table 21,
p. 57; ds Recommended operating conditions (sheets E5, E7), p. 2; ctl 7.1.3
Serial Interface, p. 17; notes Design Considerations 2 and 5, p. 1.
Logic supply of the module, recommended operating range
Datasheet Recommended operating conditions (sheets E5, E7), p. 2
Table 21 holds for VDD 2.4 V to 3.5 V at 25 °C. D/C# is sampled on
every eighth clock; the serial interface is write-only. NKK's notes give
6.6 MHz as the SCK limit of the module. Inputs: high at least 0.8 x VDD,
